attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moves the shared vue-multiselect-wrapper script from OrchardCore.ContentFields to OrchardCore.Resources and registers it in the central resource manifest with a new version pin ('vue-multiselect' now explicitly set to version 2), which is a reasonable fix but touches widely-used admin UI resources across multiple modules (ContentFields, Menu, AdminMenu, Shortcodes) and any downstream module referencing the old asp-src path or relying on default (unversioned) vue-multiselect resolution could break."}
